# NexPixel Studio

> Designing what’s next. NexPixel Studio is a Dubai-based creative technology studio designing and building websites, digital products, UI/UX, SaaS, mobile products and digital brands for UAE businesses, with remote delivery for GCC and international projects.

## Services
- [Custom websites](https://duoonex.com/services/web-design/): Responsive business websites and content management.
- [Custom applications](https://duoonex.com/services/web-app-mvp-development/): Operational workflows, dashboards and customer portals.
- [React and Next.js](https://duoonex.com/services/saas-mvp-development/): API-connected websites and application interfaces.
- [Python and AI workflows](https://duoonex.com/services/ai-mvp-development/): Business backends, APIs and scoped AI integrations.
- [Shopify development](https://duoonex.com/services/webflow/): Liquid themes, product content and store integrations.
- [WordPress development](https://duoonex.com/services/law-firm-web-design-development/): Service websites and manageable publishing.
- [UI/UX design](https://duoonex.com/services/ui-ux-design/): Figma journeys, interfaces and prototypes.

## Selected projects
- [Finora](https://duoonex.com/case-studies/finora/): A UAE-focused accounting platform connecting sales, purchases, inventory, banking and ledger-based business reports.
- [Nexora](https://duoonex.com/case-studies/nexora/): A shared workspace for support tickets, tasks, approvals and customer service, with organisation-scoped access and activity history.
- [Invitara](https://duoonex.com/case-studies/invitara/): Animated digital invitations with personalisation, guest replies, account-based publishing and event-date access rules.
- [Mechaura International](https://duoonex.com/case-studies/mechaura/): An industrial catalogue website connecting UAE buyers with product specifications, sector information and quotation enquiries.
- [WorkFlow Hub](https://duoonex.com/case-studies/workflow-hub/): An internal tool that turns incoming emails into owned tasks, drafts professional replies and chases work until it is closed.
- [DREC Property Management System](https://duoonex.com/case-studies/drec-pms/): A property and lease platform managing plots, units, subtenants, subleases, EJARI registrations, rent collection and compliance alerts.
- [CertGuard](https://duoonex.com/case-studies/certguard/): A domain and SSL control panel that verifies expiry dates against live sources, alerts before expiry and automates certificate renewal.
- [Carter Studio](https://duoonex.com/case-studies/carter-studio/): A dark, motion-led website for a freelance web studio with services, portfolio, pricing, blog and an admin CMS.
- [Rydge Studio](https://duoonex.com/case-studies/rydge-studio/): An editorial creative-studio portfolio where every word, image and section is editable from an admin backend.
